_comment: Offline exchange between the Operator machine and the CEO machine. Point shared_folder at a folder that BOTH machines keep in sync via Google Drive / Dropbox / OneDrive (the desktop client mirrors it). The app writes/reads JSON sync files there. Change the path any time and reload — no restart needed. Leave it blank to use manual download/upload instead.
_paths_help: Examples — macOS: '/Users/you/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-you@gmail.com/My Drive/SalarySync'  ·  Windows: 'C:\\Users\\you\\Google Drive\\SalarySync'  ·  Dropbox: '/Users/you/Dropbox/SalarySync'. The folder must already exist.
